premium.basis: Premium not explicitly stated in dossier; deal price of $30.00 + CVR followed FDA approval and a competitive process.

leaked_early.details: Rumors of a potential acquisition and specific bidder interest (Forest Laboratories) were reported by Bloomberg and Reuters on February 18 and 21, 2011, prior to the official announcement on February 22, 2011.

notes: Deal driven by FDA approval of Viibryd; target faced a cash runway only through May 2011, forcing a sale. Forest added a CVR to bridge valuation gap without raising upfront cash.
